entrypoint:
cp /var/lib/powerdns/pdns.sqlite3 /tmp/pdns.sqlite3
printf '%s\n' launch=gsqlite3 gsqlite3-database=/tmp/pdns.sqlite3 socket-dir=/tmp local-address=0.0.0.0 security-poll-suffix= api=yes api-key=vetchium-dev-dns-api-key webserver=yes webserver-address=0.0.0.0 webserver-port=8081 webserver-allow-from=0.0.0.0/0 > /tmp/pdns.conf
pdnsutil --config-dir=/tmp zone create example ns1.example
pdnsutil --config-dir=/tmp zone create example.com ns1.example.com
exec pdns_server --config-dir=/tmp --disable-syslog

test: sdig 127.0.0.1 53 example SOA | grep -q 'Rcode: 0 .*AA: 1' && sdig 127.0.0.1 53 example.com SOA | grep -q 'Rcode: 0 .*AA: 1'
